search.query: index=ecom_ci OR index=ecom_infra OR index=ecom_k8s | eval stage=case( sourcetype="github_actions", "CI", sourcetype="terraform", "Terraform", sourcetype="argocd", "ArgoCD", sourcetype="k8s_events", "Pod Ready" ) | stats earliest(_time) as start, latest(_time) as end by commit_sha, stage | eval duration_s = end - start | xyseries commit_sha stage duration_s
